title: AI Speech Synthesis & Lip Sync Alignment
content: For issues with AI voice-avatar lip sync: 1) Ensure source script has proper punctuation for natural pauses. 2) Source audio should be clear of background noise. 3) Select the correct language and accent profile. If a generated video has noticeable lag (audio-video offset > 100ms), report within 24 hours via Video Manager > Report Sync Issue. We regenerate affected videos free of charge. For severe cases, we escalate to our AI speech team. High-quality speech requires 16-bit mono WAV files for custom voice training.
